comment: models.dev provider ids that MAKE models and publish their own list price — the only providers the price journal records. Order is the resolve preference when a model id is listed by more than one maker (zai before zhipuai: the international list price before the mainland one). Read by crates/keepdeck-usage (catalogue) and scripts/price-history.mjs; edit here only.
labsComment: A maker also lists models other labs made, at its own resale price (alibaba sells DeepSeek's and Moonshot's). models.dev names who made a model by its base model, `<lab>/<model>` (a provider file's base_model, the catalogue's canonical_model_id): a maker's own models name its lab, which is its provider id unless `labs` says otherwise. A model of another lab is resold, and is not journaled. Read by crates/keepdeck-usage only (catalogue::made_by), for the seed and the live catalogue alike: the seed builder records each model's base model and leaves the judgment to it.
